name: Collection: stage data in a temp archive
summary: After a quick check of who they are, the intruder packs a folder into a zip in the user's temp folder, ready to take away. Uses ART's own sample folder, so no real user data is touched.
objectives: Find the archive created in the temp folder and the process that created it.
Tie the staging to the discovery that preceded it.

steps.title: Current user (whoami /all)
hunt_notes: whoami.exe: the start of the activity on {{Host}}.

steps.title: Zip a folder into the temp directory
expected_detections: PowerShell Compress-Archive writing a zip to a temp folder
hunt_notes: powershell.exe Compress-Archive: the archive lands at {{output_file}}. Find the file-write event and its source folder.
